hero.title: Family. Fire. Flavor.
hero.subtitle: High-quality meats, grilled tableside — where first-timers become regulars.

story.title: A Family Business, Rooted in Flavor.
story.quote: We want people to feel at home here.
story.paragraph1: Pro Samgyupsal began as a dream to share authentic Korean BBQ with our community. Every cut of meat, every side dish, and every warm welcome comes from our family to yours. We believe the best meals are shared around a grill with the people you care about.
story.paragraph2: From our tableside service to our carefully sourced ingredients, we treat every guest like family — because that's what we are.

experience.title: How to Enjoy Korean BBQ
experience.subtitle: New to Korean BBQ? Let us guide you through the experience.
experience.step1Desc: Watch as premium cuts sizzle on your personal tabletop grill, cooked to perfection.
experience.step2Desc: Enhance the flavor with sesame oil, ssamjang, or our house-made sauces.
experience.step3Desc: Bundle your grilled meat in crisp lettuce or pickled radish for the perfect bite.
experience.step4Desc: Korean BBQ is meant to be shared — gather around and create memories.
